title: **Relec FileUploader rejects a PDF that already
notes: carries a signature field, with a misleading size error.** Observed
2026-11-04: an Iberdrola invoice (PDF 1.6, 369 KB, Quadient Inspire,
AcroForm with `/Sig`) failed three times with
`alert("Tamaño de archivo excedido. Limite 50000 KBytes")` in any slot
order; the same file rewritten by
Next: detect that alert in `uploadRelecDocument`, report it as "the sede
refused the PDF (likely an existing signature or form)" and suggest
flattening, instead of a size error.
result: uploadRelecDocument now reports the FileUploader size alert as the sede refusing the PDF (likely an existing signature or form) and suggests flattening with gs pdfwrite, the command reading the holder's local source path shell-quoted (not the sanitised upload name); other non-uploadEnd answers keep the generic error.
evidence: pnpm check:ci green; isRelecSizeAlert.test.ts, assertRelecUploadAccepted.test.ts, mapShellArgument.test.ts and relecFetcherErrors.test.ts cover the alert and the quoted path; not re-run against the live sede.
